original.description: A Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III (No 1 Mk 3) in .303 British, photographed side-on against a plain ground from the collection of the Armémuseum, Stockholm; accession AM.032056.
original.photographer: Armémuseum (The Swedish Army Museum), Stockholm — the record credits the museum rather than an individual
original.date: catalogued image, on DigitaltMuseum by 2012; the object is an SMLE Mk III (introduced 1907)
original.archive: Armémuseum (Swedish Army Museum), Stockholm, AM.032056; object record on DigitaltMuseum; via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"; AttributionRequired false. The record's permission note is that the photograph was released into the public domain by its copyright owner, Armémuseum, Stockholm). Credited here anyway, because the museum asks to be named on DigitaltMuseum.

colorization.status: not colorized, and must not be — a modern colour photograph of the object.

content_policy: ok — a museum object photographed on its own; no casualties
caption: The Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III: ten rounds, two chargers, a bolt worked without taking the hand off the grip. The rifle behind the fire the German infantry at Mons took for machine guns. Armémuseum, Stockholm.
credit: Photograph: Armémuseum (The Swedish Army Museum), Stockholm, AM.032056, via DigitaltMuseum and Wikimedia Commons; released into the public domain by the museum.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The record does not date the example, only the pattern; the caption claims the pattern and not the year of manufacture.
